codec_static_copy.rule: Exactly accepted350 closed codec before its command-denial guard, statically copied as shape validator only; no dynamic code loading or model oracle.

path_rule: Caller supplies all ordered explicit absolute locations. No discovery/default path/network/extraction/code interpretation. No empty/dot/dotdot/backslash/control components, symlink ancestors/leaves, directories/special files or multi-link leaf. Descriptor relative open with O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY/O_CLOEXEC and nonblocking leaf; never write/create/truncate/exec.
raw_rule: Opaque bytes retained unchanged, including empty text, executable-looking payloads or archive-looking magic. Never parse/execute/extract raw contents here. Structured observation parsing and semantic comparisons remain353-355; archive bytes are never an envelope or implicit expanded observations.
read_rule: Size snapshot cannot exceed declared cap before reading; retained bytes at most declared size, one extra detection byte discarded. All declared sums bounded128MiB;64MiB/file. Initial oversized data remains conflicting without read. Chunk65536. Raw complete bytes retain independent byte SHA; partial reads never claim full digest. Byte/memory bounds do not promise wall-clock deadline or native trusted time.
snapshot_rule: Record file device/inode/mode/uid/gid/nlink/size/mtime/ctime before/after, compare visible leaf and every bound ancestor identity. Detect observable races, not continuous writer exclusion or authenticated native provenance. File disappearance after binding/read failure keeps conflict and bounded partial data when available.
state_rule: Declared conflict or any read contradiction remains conflict even with missing/unknown peers. Declared unknown stays unknown even matching raw hashes; mixed captured/missing is partial unknown. Missing is missing data, never host/effect absence. Captured-unverified means bytes match declarations, never independent/native evidence.
